cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Help me sort our letters before the removal van comes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We filled it over ten years. I shouldn't have to decide alone what survives us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose a day we'll open it together. Taking it away can't mean you inherit all the deciding.

mechanism: A treats its former partner as a trained sorter, using corrective praise to make both stay responsible for deciding what shared history to keep.
confusable: Not simply getting rid of a box: even B taking it cannot remove the shared decision burden.
comparison: Family care administration versus separation and old letters.
seedUse: D77 letters/ten years/removal van/future joint opening; S05 learned sorting and responsibility.
